Questions, answered

Good giving starts with clarity

Your gift is assigned to the campaign you choose. Each project page shows its budget, local partner, delivery milestones, and funding updates.

Receipts are provided by the registered charitable partner handling your contribution. Eligibility depends on your country and local tax rules.

Yes. Monthly gifts help projects plan essential work with greater confidence. You can change or stop recurring support at any time.

Volunteer opportunities depend on local needs. Tell us your location and skills, and our team will connect you with a suitable partner.

We welcome matched giving, team fundraising, pro-bono support, and longer-term partnerships built around measurable community goals.
